Show codes for
How to enter

Type the code during play. There is no console and no Enter key. On the mobile Definitive Edition, including the Netflix version, type the code with a keyboard (an external one on iPhone and iPad).

Cheats turn off achievements and trophies for the session. Keep a clean save. Using a lot of cheats can make Burning Desire, Life's a Beach, Photo Opportunity and Madd Dogg impossible to finish.
